name: Rongo Delgado-Opoku
role: High-risk package and data transport — courier
location: The Narrows — cramped residential corridors between megastructures, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Rongo Delgado-Opoku is tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 28, her face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Rongo Delgado-Opoku plans to keep it that way. She works as a courier out of The Narrows, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

In the runner community, Rongo Delgado-Opoku is known for getting the job done and not asking questions that would make the job harder to stomach.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
core_desires: Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
coping_mechanisms: Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
blind_spots: Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
psychology.secret: Rongo Delgado-Opoku sends anonymous tips to GLMZ law enforcement about competitors. It's not principle — it's market manipulation.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse to the point of rudeness. Treats words like ammunition — expensive and not to be wasted.
speech_patterns.cadence: Conversational and disarming — sounds like a neighbor until the content registers.
verbal_tics: Never uses contractions when lying — 'I did not' instead of 'I didn't'
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
example_lines: "I don't look inside the package. I don't ask about the package. I deliver the package."
"Speed is a skill. Knowing when to slow down is wisdom. I sell both."
"This route has three checkpoints and a kill zone. I'll be there in twenty minutes."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Rongo Delgado-Opoku a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
Rongo Delgado-Opoku's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
Rongo Delgado-Opoku is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: As a courier, Rongo Delgado-Opoku embodies the tension between independence and isolation. She is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation. Neural dampener — blocks external hacking attempts, passive ICE in the brain
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Semi-independent — has standing arrangements with several crews

strengths: social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
habits: Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Talks to their gear — names weapons, thanks tools, treats equipment as companions
breaking_points: A child being put in danger as leverage against them
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended

physical_description.build: Rawboned and angular — lean muscle without softness, the frame of someone who burns calories faster than she replaces them. Shoulders broad but lack bulk; visible muscle definition in forearms and legs suggests constant movement rather than gym discipline.
physical_description.hair_color: Deep brown, naturally dark with subtle red undertones in direct light
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a utilitarian braid, sometimes left loose. Practical, never decorative.
physical_description.hair_length: Long — reaches mid-back when unbraided, but worn tied up 90% of the time
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, alert and flat — the kind of stare that suggests she's already calculated your threat assessment
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-warm complexion, the blend of West African and Latin American heritage creating a tone that shifts between bronze and clay depending on light and rest levels
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with high cheekbones and a squared jaw. Minimal grooming — no cosmetics, scars left unsmoothed. Skin shows the wear of irregular sleep and constant low-grade stress; slight dark circles are permanent fixtures. Lips thin, mouth set in a default neutral line.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar along her left jawline, approximately 6cm, running from ear toward chin — looks like a blade wound, old enough to have faded but too precise to be accidental
Cluster of small burns on the inside of her right wrist, faint and somewhat hidden by her sleeve line — appears to be chemical or thermal in origin, deliberate-looking but not decorative
Tattoo on her left collarbone area, partially visible: a minimalist geometric pattern suggesting a stylized bird in flight, done in black ink — runner culture marker
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome visible along both forearms in the form of reinforced wiring and interface ports — synthetic silver-grey metal work visible at wrist and elbow joints, practical rather than ornamental. Neural port at the base of her skull, behind her left ear, marked by a small raised seam and a faint shimmer of subdermal circuitry. Her eyes themselves don't glow, but there's an almost imperceptible flicker when she's processing data or making threat assessments — tells if you know what to look for. The adrenaline pump augmentation creates a subtle tension in her chest and shoulders, a readiness that never fully relaxes.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with the efficiency of someone who's trained out of her natural grace — controlled, minimal wasted motion, weight balanced on the balls of her feet even when standing still. Shoulders slightly forward, head slightly cocked, as if always half-turning toward potential threats. Her hands rest naturally at her sides but are never truly still — fingers move in small patterns, testing tension, checking gear. She doesn't fidget; she calibrates.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 working-class courier aesthetic — function over fashion, but not poverty-coded. Black synthetic leather jacket (weathered, multiple repair patches, burn mark on the right sleeve), reinforced cargo pants in slate grey with pockets positioned for quick access and gear distribution, worn commuter boots with grippy soles. Thin base layer under the jacket, visible collarbone area for neural port accessibility. No visible jewelry except a thin bracelet on her right wrist — likely serves a functional purpose (timepiece, data interface, or reminder). Bag is a tactical sling pack, dark fabric, custom-modified with hidden compartments and signal-blocking lining. Clothing deliberately unremarkable — designed not to catch attention, to blend into runner infrastructure.
